title: onoclea scandens
intro: Onoclea scandens, commonly known as the climbing fern, is a species of fern native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Onoclea scandens include its use as an antiseptic, astringent, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it effective in treating wounds, skin conditions, and other health issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
